title: Habitat Ecological Niche
definition: Habitat is the physical 'address' where an organism lives, while an Ecological Niche is the functional 'profession' or role an organism plays within its ecosystem, encompassing its interactions with biotic and abiotic factors.
importanceInUpsc: Fundamental to Environment & Ecology (GS Paper III). Frequently tested in Prelims regarding species interactions, competitive exclusion, and ecosystem stability.
learningOutcomes: Master foundational concepts and mechanisms of Habitat Ecological Niche.
Evaluate spatial distribution, institutional frameworks, and policy dimensions.
Apply high-yield mnemonics to solve tricky Prelims and Mains questions.
